modern: Look at everything that exists, and observe that it is already dissolving and changing, and as it were decaying or dispersing, or that everything is so made by nature as to die.
original: Look at everything that exists, and observe that it is already in dissolution and in change, and as it were putrefaction or dispersion, or that everything is so constituted by nature as to die.

explained.summary: Look at anything around you and notice that it is already coming apart, changing, rotting or scattering. Everything is made by nature to die. Seeing decay already at work, instead of waiting to be surprised by it, loosens your grip on things and makes their loss less of a shock.
explained.today: The new car is already losing value, the phone is already heading for obsolescence, and the flowers on the table are already wilting. Seeing that plainly can make it easier to enjoy them without clinging.
